references.text: Import individual existing primitives from `@/runa/ui` (Vite, Vitest and TypeScript share the alias). The facade exports Button, Tooltip, Icon, Form, Select, LoadingOverlay and Logo without importing a layout, router, registry or global installation. Include the application's `src/runa/resources/css/app.css` for theme tokens/fonts/styles. The underlying App-prefixed components remain the single implementations.

`MinimalLayout`, `IdentityProvider` and `Footer` are public exports from `@/runa/ui`. The default welcome uses MinimalLayout; AuthLayout was removed by owner request. MinimalLayout includes the supplied Runa illustration by default; the content/default slot occupies the left side, matching `/`. Named header/header-actions/content/illustration/actions/footer slots permit overrides; `illustration: false` explicitly selects a single column. The default header owns existing locale/theme controls; replacing it replaces those controls too. Footer visibility applies to custom footer slots as well.

Import `ApplicationLayout`, `usePageResolver`, `createPageResolver`, `createPreferenceStore`, `usePreference` and their types from `@/runa/ui`. ApplicationLayout needs no module discovery or router installation; optional Auth session discovery binds account preferences when available. Supply navigation descriptors, a title and current URL-derived RouteContext; handle its `navigate(href, event)` event with your resolver. `localeChange(locale)` emits the initial and subsequent locale so callers can translate navigation labels without initializing another locale composable. Modified/middle clicks retain native browser behavior. Standalone component consumers still initialize no shell or preferences.

Public `@/runa/ui` action imports include Button, ButtonGroup and Icon, with exported ControlSize/ControlTone/ButtonVariant types. Controls remain shell-independent. Button preserves its original neutral/md appearance and compact compatibility; explicit variants use shared semantic tokens. Busy state blocks native activation. ButtonGroup joins adjacent controls with one divider. ApplicationLayout consumes Button while retaining its unique initials profile control. Action-list/split buttons and reusable avatars are deferred until a concrete need exists, per owner review. See the component catalogue for full contracts.

Public `@/runa/ui` exports Alert, Badge, Status, Tooltip, Popover, ToastViewport, FormNotifications and setup-scoped useToasts. Feedback uses neutral/success/info/warning/danger roles. Neutral alerts/toasts use the ordinary raised surface, secondary text and control border, without a status tint. Readable labels and alert symbols supplement color. Static badges/statuses do not announce automatically; Alert provides live semantics unless explicitly disabled. ToastViewport supplies one polite region, explicit close controls and top-right responsive placement. Its local queue defaults to 5-second notifications and persistent errors, pauses remaining time on hover/focus and restores the invoking control when a focused toast is dismissed. FormNotifications presents operation successes and form-wide failures only in that

The public `@/runa/ui` facade exports Card (header/actions/body/footer slots), Divider, controlled Accordion, Tabs, Dropdown, Breadcrumbs and Pagination. These components work without a shell or router. Tabs use stable typed IDs, named content slots, automatic arrow/Home/End activation and preserved hidden panels. Dropdown composes the existing floating Popover as an arbitrary-content nonmodal disclosure; no action-list/split-button API is added. Breadcrumbs exposes optional native-event interception for the page resolver. Pagination emits bounded page requests and never fetches data. Callers supply localized accessible names and own selection/loading/query changes. The component catalogue documents exact props, fallback behavior and events; specialized shell navigation remains internal.

`@/runa/modules` supplies ModulePage, ModuleSlot, build/runtime types, createModuleComponents, modulePages, moduleNavigation and useModuleFrontend. The two components are also exported through the UI facade. Import `virtual:runa-module-components` only in an entry that consumes modules; ordinary customer frontends need neither this registry nor the module projection request. The existing exact URL resolver and ApplicationLayout navigation remain the composition contracts. The application entry explicitly handles loading/unavailable/unknown routes and refreshes metadata on navigation/recovery; module page setup runs only after current availability and build-hash checks. Slots preserve server ordering and require exact scalar props before mounting. Tailwind scans both owned module source roots; module utility names must remain static. See [module frontend contracts](module-framework.md#delivered-frontend-pages-and-named-slots) for server routes, permissions, build mapping, ordering and freshness limits.
Exact Auth entry paths render the lazy `AuthEntry` component from `@/runa/auth`

Derive PascalCode by capitalizing and joining code segments. Reject case-insensitive PHP prefix collisions, including collisions with ordinary application/platform classes, rather than silently renaming a prefix. The local autoloader derives an explicit prefix-to-`backend/` mapping from the synchronized registry snapshot: broad `App\`/`Runa\` Composer mappings alone do not handle lowercase module roots. No per-module dependency or Composer autoload edit is required. It checks the source manifest hash and canonical owned class path before loading; loading a class does not instantiate descriptors or activate a module.

Version components are decimal integers without leading zeros, at most nine digits each. Version constraints reuse `Runa\Support\VersionCompatibility`: exact or `=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `^`, `~` against complete stable triples; whitespace is AND and `||` is OR, maximum 256 characters. Wildcards, partial versions, prereleases and build metadata are unsupported in v1 compatibility evaluation and fail explicitly. Do not use the dev-only transitive Composer SemVer package at runtime. Module versions and framework API versions are independent of platform VERSION; the initial framework API contract is `1.0.0` when delivered.
After forward platform migrations, installation/deployment code can call `Runa\Support\Modules\ModuleRegistry::synchronize('runa')` or `synchronize('app')`, or invoke the trusted CLI equivalent:

`Runa\Support\Modules\ModuleGraph` takes a `RegistrySnapshot`, the running platform version and framework API version (default `1.0.0`). Records expose validated required/optional maps and platform/framework constraints from the persisted manifest in the same locked snapshot as flags and generation. Planning reads no source files, executes no descriptors and writes nothing.

`Runa\Contracts\Modules\LifecyclePreview` has schema version 1, intent, target, generation, ordered `affected` IDs, proposed `changes` (`module ID => enabled`) and immutable `GraphBlocker` values. Enable traverses required edges in lexical order and emits dependencies before consumers, once per module. Already enabled modules remain in the affected graph for validation but need no flag change. Disable traverses enabled registered required dependents and emits consumers before dependencies. Disabled consumers and optional edges never join that cascade. Missing source retains its last validated edges for safe disable planning. Enabling a dependency never includes its previously disabled consumers.

Declare zero or one source-owned `Runa\Contracts\Modules\HealthPolicy` in `declarations.health`. Its `schemaVersion()` is 1; `definition($overrides)` returns immutable `HealthDefinition`/`HealthCheck` values and rejects every unsupported override. `check($checkId, HealthContext)` returns a boolean, never a raw upstream payload. Definition revisions cover all module-owned decision inputs. An empty health declaration supplies no special checks and no editable health overrides.

List owned `ApiProvider` descriptor classes in `declarations.apis`. Each returns `ApiDefinition(contract, proxy, implementation, version, operations, schemaVersion: 1)`. The contract is an owned `backend/Contracts/` interface; the final proxy extends `Runa\Support\Modules\Api\GuardedApi` and implements that interface; the concrete implementation implements the same interface. The version is an exact bounded stable `X.Y.Z`, separate from module/source/framework versions. A consumer requests an exact contract version; unsupported versions or duplicate declarations fail closed. Use separate interface identities for simultaneously supported versions.

Use `Runa\Support\Modules\Data\ModuleSchema($connection, $identity)` in explicit migrations. `create($table, $columns, $exposed = true)` supplies a bigint `GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY` primary key and, for exposed entities, unique non-null UUIDv7 `public_id` with a database version/variant constraint. Add business columns, `timestampsTz()` and `softDeletesTz()` in the Blueprint callback. Set `exposed: false` for technical/pivot rows without external identity. The generated public-ID index has a bounded identity-derived name even with maximum-length schemas/tables; give other long index/FK names explicit short names.

`Runa\Support\Modules\Management\ModuleManagement::read(moduleId)` returns the schema-version-1 `Runa\Contracts\Modules\ModuleManagement` DTO. Trusted CLI `php artisan runa:modules:management app.example` prints the same JSON. It combines the current administrative/effective status and safe root-cause paths, localized identity, required/optional dependency constraints, redacted settings with types/defaults/validation/application/revisions, integration toggle/config metadata, bounded active work and source-owned permission/action/custom-component descriptors. Settings without a provider are null. Sensitive settings expose only set-state; private payloads, lease tokens, executable classes and provider exception text are excluded. Integration configuration is non-sensitive by contract. Missing source preserves status/dependencies/retained work and reports `declaration_source_unavailable`. Known invalid declarations/settings/integrations produce explicit safe diagnostic codes and omit the affected section; metadata errors never change enabled flags. CLI exits 1 for those incomplete views or unknown modules; unavailable business state alone does not fail a complete metadata read.

Extend `Runa\Support\Seeding\ManagedSeeder`, implement `category()` and `seed(SeedContext)`, and declare `dependsOn()` as class names. Register each application class explicitly in `src/app/config/seeding.php` under `register`; dependencies must also be registered. Classes must reside within `src/app` and extend `ManagedSeeder`; platform seeders cannot enter this graph. A loose file under any category folder does not execute automatically. The application `DatabaseSeeder` may also explicitly call ordinary application seeders using Laravel's standard API. Names are sorted deterministically, then topologically ordered. The entire graph is checked for missing dependencies, cycles and category violations before any seed is executed. Production may depend only on production; development cannot depend on occasional scenarios. The occasional command accepts a unique short name or full registered class name and executes only its dependency closure. Production rejects any closure containing development seeders.

Search this catalogue and the source before introducing a new control. First-use page-local elements are allowed; on second use, extract the common application element into `src/app/resources/js/components/`, migrate both consumers and document the local application contract in the same task. Consume platform exports through `@/runa/ui`; platform extension requires a Runa owner release. Keep entries limited to implemented components. Public imports use `@/runa/ui`: Button, Tooltip, Icon, Form, Select, LoadingOverlay and Logo map to their existing App-prefixed/RunaLogo implementations. No layout/router installation is required; load the application theme CSS in the consuming entry. IdentityProvider, MinimalLayout and Footer are also public; navigation and preferences now have resolver/storage implementations; bounded CSV/XLSX/PDF engines, printing and operation/provider contracts are available.

- Public `Card`, `Divider`, `Accordion`, `Tabs`, `Dropdown`, `Breadcrumbs`, `Pagination` map to `src/runa/resources/js/components/App*.vue`; types `TabItem`/`BreadcrumbItem` come from `@/runa/ui`. No shell, router or global installation is required.

`src/runa/resources/js/components/AppTablePreferences.vue` supplies a sm icon-only ghost settings button with a localized accessible name/Tooltip, matching export settings, plus the optional sm Available views selector (Default view first) and shared Dialog for column visibility, drag/keyboard order, a compact numeric width/px field with measured initial value and automatic reset; named views support create/select/update/rename/delete/default/reset. `useTableViews` owns scoped persistence, schema migration/reconciliation and controlled query snapshots. Import both through `@/runa/ui`; connect its columns to Table's optional columnState. See [tables.md](tables.md) for the public contract and example. No existing layout has provisional table settings to replace.

TableActions composes sm icon export/print actions, a scope/orientation settings Popover and contextual bulk controls with the reusable OperationPanel and useOperation controller. Real bounded browser adapters and an optional API export provider are exported through @/runa/ui; no shell or backend jobs are installed. OperationPanel supports progress, permission errors, partial counts, retry/cancel and download. Table's toolbar slot exposes feedbackTarget; pass it to TableActions to keep operation feedback in the full-width outlet below aligned controls. See [tables.md](tables.md) for contracts, bounds, server authorization/idempotency and notices. Both existing layouts were inspected: neither has provisional export/bulk controls to replace; the test-only ScenarioTables fixture demonstrates both client and simulated server integrations.
- `src/runa/resources/js/components/ModulePage.vue` and `ModuleSlot.vue`; public imports through `@/runa/modules` or the UI facade. They introduce no replacement layout/control styling or motion.
